items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1974-01-01
items.q: Your wife reminded us about Ben having her own language and chick keys and doing a restaurant. ... And for instance, we would come to town and the menu had certain prices when it came for us to pay.

ctx.x: They can find, they can find the most flimsy excuse. Yeah. Not to want to be with you or not to like you. It doesn't make a bit of sense if you ask them why, they couldn't answer. Yeah.
Your wife reminded us about Ben having her own language and chick keys and doing a restaurant.

Yeah, different things like that. And for instance, we would come to town and the menu had certain prices when it came for us to pay. It was a nickel, a dime, a quarter moment was on the menu. So you would ask the guy about that and you would tell you, well that's the end for the people in town. Out of town people had a different price. And then too we had the language of our own.
